source.title: Some open problems in geometric topology of low dimensions

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL for document identifier 1578090. The zbMATH web record could not be used as readable full text because direct local fetching returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge, and the available page reader did not expose the record body as a readable technical source.

Local resolver metadata and exact-title search identified the exact work as Alberto Cavicchioli and Dusan Repovs, "Some open problems in geometric topology of low dimensions," Shuxue Jikan / Chinese Quarterly Journal of Mathematics 10(4), pages 8-14, 1995. The IRIS repository page and author CV entries were metadata-only and stated no associated full-text file; they were used only for title and identity recovery, not extraction.

trace.notes: Bounded recovery attempted the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, and the exact title plus first author. Candidate pages inspected or found were rejected because they were metadata-only repository records, author CV bibliographies, ResearchGate/profile entries not retrievable as readable primary full text in this run, or different works. No exact-work readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No candidates were accepted because the workflow forbids extracting open problems from abstracts, bibliographic metadata, search snippets, author CVs, or inaccessible full-text links when the technical problem statements are not visible in a chosen primary source artifact.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1578090.json and outputs/latest.json.
